name: Computer Use
description: Let the agent see and drive this Mac: screen capture, app activation, and keyboard input through osascript. Every call passes the host permission engine; the tool stays disabled until enabled in plugin settings.
author: LaboFlow

agentTools.name: computer
agentTools.description: See and drive this Mac (macOS only): take a screenshot to a file, activate an application, type text into the focused app, or press a key by macOS key code. Every action requires permission; disabled until enabled in plugin settings.

key.description: key: macOS key code, e.g. 36 Return, 48 Tab, 53 Escape

settings.title: Enable Computer Use
settings.description: Registers the computer tool. Every call still goes through the permission engine; macOS accessibility (TCC) is required.
